options.title: What Happens Inside Your Engine When You Turn the Key?
options.first_line: Turn the key, and a tiny gear inside your engine shoots out and grabs it.
options.first_frame: A car key already turning in the ignition while the engine beside it is sliced open, the starter's small gear sliding forward toward the big ring gear.

options.title: How Does a Motor This Small Start a Whole Engine?
options.first_line: This motor fits in your hand, yet it spins a whole car engine to life.
options.first_frame: A hand-sized starter motor, cut open and already spinning, set against the much bigger engine block it is about to crank.

options.title: The Hidden Gear That Starts Your Car Every Morning
options.first_line: Every time you start your car, a hidden gear punches into the engine, then jumps back out.
options.first_frame: A cutaway of the flywheel's ring gear with the small pinion gear snapping into its teeth and back out, the camera pushing in.

why: A hand-sized motor next to a huge engine block raises a 'how is that possible?' question you can see with the sound off, and neither the title nor the first line gives away how it does it.
